text:
Type: large medallion wool rug
Use: anchoring a living or dining area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: traditional, classic
Materials: wool, low pile, fringed ends
Colors: dark charcoal grey field, ivory, tan, beige
Shape: large rectangle, central round floral medallion, dense Persian-style florals, wide ivory border, fringe on short ends
Feel: elegant, refined, grounded
Goes with: dark wood furniture, cream upholstery, warm neutrals; traditional or classic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Modern Dusk Wool Rug, 8' x 10', Tan
product.description: Pile: 80% Wool/20% Cotton, Backing: 100% Jute Imported This beautiful cream-colored rug combines a classic medallion pattern with durable and resilient natural fibers. Neutral colors and classic style will allow this rug to blend with any of your existing styles in high-traffic areas. Classic design with modern durability Hand-hooked in India. 80% wool, 20% cotton. Fashionable with minimal care 8' x 10' Pairs with a rug pad (sold separately) Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
